transcript: In Deep Blue Sound, the Clubbed Thumb production which is back at The Public for a return engagement, the residents of a small island in the Pacific Northwest are all experiencing changes, big and small. Some connections grow, others fray. A sense of languishing and weariness permeates. Community and isolation seem to be at odds with one another. And on top of all of that, the whales are nowhere to be found. This is a gorgeous ensemble piece that renders a delicate and melancholic kaleidoscope of ideas that meet this moment perfectly. I found it very resonant and I love the way it flowed sort of like a documentary, seamlessly transitioning between different through lines, all of which were incrementally developing. Funny but quietly devastating, this is an ode to the profundity of small, personal experiences in an endlessly vast and expansive world outside of us. Deep Blue Sound is running through March 29th. With that, another program for my collection.
